Name: Siege Ogre
Source: Lyres Guide to Risk and Reward
Information:
An irregularly large ogre that towers above others. These massive creatures are the result of several deformities, requiring massive amounts of food and having lackluster perception. Due to their size they can be outfitted with a harness to have other creatures ride them, making them useful mounts for warbands that can come to an understanding with it.

***Mass Consumption.*** Siege ogres become hungry quickly, thanks to a metabolism that burns faster than normal. If an ogre does not eat its share every day, it takes a level of Exhaustion without rolling, but while it has these levels of exhaustion it flies into a rage and has advantage on all attack rolls and Strength-based rolls it makes until it eats. Once it has consumed enough food, all levels of exhaustion caused by starving disappear immediately. Due to this, some particularly cruel masters may starve a siege ogre before a large battle to unleash its feral fury upon their enemies.

traits.name: Mobile Battlement
traits.description: Siege ogres can be fitted with a harness and platform that allows a Medium or smaller creature to ride atop it. A creature doing so can command the ogre as an independent mount, and have half-cover while riding atop it. A creature riding the ogre has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks. A creature riding the ogre who takes 30 or more damage from a single attack must make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw, falling from the ogre on a failure. The creature riding the ogre cannot hit creatures surrounding the ogre with weapons unless they have a reach/range of 15 feet or more (unless the target is over the ogre’s head and within 5 feet of the rider).

traits.name: Terrible Constitution
traits.description: The ogre has disadvantage on saving throws against being poisoned due to its immune system being more vulnerable than most creatures.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The ogre makes three Reinforced Pummel attacks, or two Rock Hurl attacks.

actions.name: Reinforced Pummel
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., 1 target. Hit: 23 (3d10 + 6) bludgeoning damage. If the target is Medium or smaller they are knocked prone or back 10 feet (the ogre’s choice).

actions.name: Rock Hurl
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, range 30/90 ft., 1 target. Hit: 33 (5d10 + 6) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Throw Creature
actions.description: The ogre attempts to grab a creature within 10 feet of it, which must be Medium or smaller. The target must make a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw or be picked up. The ogre then throws the creature at another creature or space it can see within 40 feet of itself. If the creature collides with a solid surface they (and the surface) take 32 (4d12 + 6) bludgeoning damage. If they collide with a creature, that creature must make the same Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, both creatures take the damage and are knocked prone, and on a success only the thrown creature does. In either case the thrown creature falls prone.

bonus_actions.name: Shield Rider
bonus_actions.description: The ogre redirects an attack or effect targeting its rider to itself, then takes half damage (rounded down) from the triggering damage.
